{{nihongo|'''Takakamo Shrine'''|高鴨神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Takakamo Shrine''' (たかかもじんじゃ) is a shrine on the eastern foothills of {{ill|Mount Kongō|Q1348310|qid=Q1348310}} in Kamogami, {{ill|Gose, Nara|Q847334|qid=Q847334}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964}}). Former rank was prefectural shrine.

It calls itself the head shrine of Kamo shrines nationwide (with names such as Kamo / Gamo / Kamo), including {{ill|Kamo shrines|Q1306606|qid=Q1306606}} in {{ill|Kyoto|Q34600|qid=Q34600}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}} ({{ill|Kamigamo Shrine|Q700448|qid=Q700448|lt=Kamowakeikazuchi Shrine}} and {{ill|Shimogamo Shrine|Q701620|qid=Q701620|lt=Kamomioya Shrine}}). In relation to {{ill|Katsuragi Mitoshi Shrine|Q11620955|qid=Q11620955}} (Naka-Kamo-sha) and {{ill|Kamo Tsuba Shrine|Q11675614|qid=Q11675614}} (Shimo-Kamo-sha), it is called "Kami-Kamo-sha."

From mid-April to early May, over 2,200 pots of more than 500 varieties of {{ill|Primula sieboldii|Q1151677|qid=Q1151677}} bloom.

=== Enshrined deities ===
The principal {{ill|Saijin|Q11591100|qid=Q11591100}} is {{ill|Ajisukitakahikone|Q506610|qid=Q506610|lt=Ajisukitakahikone-no-Mikoto}} (Kamo no Ōmikami). Associated deities are {{ill|Shitateruhime|Q11307233|qid=Q11307233|lt=Shitateruhime-no-Mikoto}} (daughter of Ōkuninushi), {{ill|Ame no Wakahiko|Q10940674|qid=Q10940674|lt=Amenowakahiko-no-Mikoto}} (husband of Shitateruhime), {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}}, and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ajisukihayao-no-Mikoto}} (child of the principal deity).

At the sessha Higashi Shrine are enshrined {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami}}, and {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Sumiyoshi Sanzen Ōkami}}. At the sessha Nishi Shrine are enshrined {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tagirihime-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ame-no-Mikatsuhime-no-Mikoto}} (consort of the principal deity), {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shionihiko-no-Mikoto}} (child), and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Takitsuhiko-no-Mikoto}} (child).

It is thought that originally only Ajisukitakahikone and Shitateruhime were enshrined, and later, under influence of mythology, Amenowakahiko (as Shitateruhime's husband) and Tagirihime (as mother) were added. However, there are many differing theories on deities other than the principal one. '{{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|Q11571092|qid=Q11571092}}' gives Ajisukitakahikone and Tagirihime; another theory says deities other than the principal are unknown.

=== Origin ===
This area is the birthplace of the {{ill|Kamo no Ason clan|Q122979457|qid=Q122979457|lt=Kamo clan}} and this shrine was enshrined as their {{ill|Ujigami|Q767655|qid=Q767655}}. Branches of the clan moved from these hills into the {{ill|Nara Basin|Q10942269|qid=Q10942269}}: a branch that moved to the bank of the {{ill|Katsuragi River|Q11620895|qid=Q11620895}} enshrined {{ill|Kamo Tsuba Shrine|Q11675614|qid=Q11675614}}, and one that moved to Higashi-Mochida enshrined {{ill|Katsuragi Mitoshi Shrine|Q11620955|qid=Q11620955}}. Later, Takakamo Shrine came to be called Kami-Kamo-sha, Mitoshi Shrine Naka-Kamo-sha, and Kamotsuba Shrine Shimo-Kamo-sha.

In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as "Takakamo Ajisukitakihikone-no-Mikoto Shrine, four seats," ranked myojin-taisha, and noted as receiving offerings at monthly, aidame, and niiname rites.

=== Facilities ===
=== Sessha ===
* Higashi Shrine ({{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu Ōmikami}}, {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Sumiyoshi Sanzen Ōkami}})
* Nishi Shrine (principal deity {{ill|Three Munakata Goddesses|Q10948069|qid=Q10948069|lt=Tagirihime-no-Mikoto}}, associated deities Ame-no-Mikatsuhime-no-Mikoto, Shionihiko-no-Mikoto, Takitsuhiko-no-Mikoto)

=== Massha ===
Hachiman Shrine, Hitokotonushi Shrine, Sarutahiko Shrine, Kotohira Shrine, Hijiri Shrine, Inari Shrine, Matsuo Shrine, Hosoi Shrine, Ōyama Shrine, Kasuga Shrine, Ikazuchi Shrine, Ichikishima Shrine, Yasaka Shrine, Nishi-Sami Shrine, Haraedo Shrine, Ushitaki Shrine, Sami Gokoku Shrine
